```{r include=FALSE}

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(arrow)
library(lubridate)
library(estimatr)
library(stargazer)

Sys.setenv(lang = "en_US")
```



```{r}
save_path_entsoe_output <- 'C:/Users/DBT3KD/Desktop/Etude_macro_elec/prix_electricite_gitlab/Intra_day_instrumnet_motivation/ENTSOE/outputs/final'
setwd(save_path_entsoe_output)

first_stage_data <- read_parquet('first_stage_data.parquet')

capacity_fields <- c("Published.Unavailable.Capacity"          
,"Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity","Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity"        
,"Unpublished.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity" ,"wind_solar_tot"                          
, "gen_tot", "Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity")

#adjuster l'ordre de grandeur des indispos pour ne pas avoir des coefficients nuls
first_stage_data_clean <- first_stage_data%>%
  filter(is.finite(log_price_diff) & 
           is.finite(Published.Unavailable.Capacity))%>% 
   mutate(across(all_of(capacity_fields), 
                ~ . / 1000))%>% 
  mutate(Published.Unavailable.Share = Published.Unavailable.Share - Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Share,
         Unpublished.Unavailable.Share = Unpublished.Unavailable.Share - Unpublished.Unavailable.Nuclear.Share)

first_stage_data_clean_pre_2021 <- first_stage_data_clean %>% 
  filter(as.Date(electricity_delivery_date) < '2021-01-01')
 
first_stage_data_clean_post_2021 <- first_stage_data_clean %>% 
  filter(as.Date(electricity_delivery_date) >= '2021-01-01')

```


```{r}
library(sandwich)
library(lmtest)

non_finite_rows <- first_stage_data %>%
  filter(!is.finite(log_price_diff) | !is.finite(Published.Unavailable.Capacity))

```
Estimation after 2021 the REMIT publication policy

```{r}

library(sandwich)
library(lmtest)


# perform first stage regression
m_basic_post <- lm(
  log_price_diff ~ Published.Unavailable.Share + Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Share  + gen_tot,
  data= first_stage_data_clean_post_2021)
# Matrice de variance-covariance clusterisée
vcov_cluster <- vcovHC(m_basic_post, type = "HC0", cluster = ~ auction_date_plus_one)
# Erreurs standard clusterisées
cl_se_basic_post <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))

# dummy for creneau
m_creneau_post <- lm(
  log_price_diff ~ Published.Unavailable.Share + Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Share  + gen_tot + as.factor(creneau) ,
  data= first_stage_data_clean_post_2021)
vcov_cluster <- vcovHC(m_creneau_post, type = "HC0", cluster = ~ auction_date_plus_one)
# Erreurs standard clusterisées
cl_se_creneau_post <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))
# use controls
# put a dummy for the number of the auction
# put a dummy for the creneau

# warning cannot put a dummy for date + creneau + auction
# full determination, no variation
m_control_post <- lm(
  log_price_diff ~ Published.Unavailable.Share + Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Share + gen_tot +
    as.factor(creneau) + factor(auction_before),
  data= first_stage_data_clean_post_2021)
vcov_cluster <- vcovHC(m_control_post, type = "HC0", cluster = ~ auction_date_plus_one)
# Erreurs standard clusterisées
cl_se_control_post <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))

```

Interpretation
for the basic model,
for a given unavailability of 1 percentage point,
the electricity price increases by 0.9 %



```{r, results = 'asis'}
# Create LaTeX code with regression results
reg_table <- stargazer(m_basic_post, m_creneau_post, m_control_post, 
    type = "html",
    se = list(cl_se_basic_post, cl_se_creneau_post, cl_se_control_post),
    title = "Regression Results",
    column.labels = c("Basic", "Timeslot FE", 'Timeslot + Auction FE'),
    keep = c('Constant', 'Published.Unavailable.Share', "Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Share", 'gen_tot')
 )
```

Dernier test, on utilise les unavailabilities calculées par le mmodèle de random forest.
Et l'on compare avec l'indispo déclarée

```{r}

# perform first stage regression
m_real <- lm(
  log_price_diff ~ Predicted.Unavailable.Share + gen_tot,
  data= first_stage_data_clean_post_2021)
# Matrice de variance-covariance clusterisée
vcov_cluster <- vcovHC(m_real, type = "HC0", cluster = ~ auction_date_plus_one)
# Erreurs standard clusterisées
cl_se_real <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))


m_real_published <- lm(
  log_price_diff ~ Predicted.Unavailable.Share + Published.Unavailable.Share + gen_tot,
  data= first_stage_data_clean_post_2021)
# Matrice de variance-covariance clusterisée
vcov_cluster <- vcovHC(m_real_published, type = "HC0", cluster = ~ auction_date_plus_one)
# Erreurs standard clusterisées
cl_se_real_published <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))

# perform first stage regression
m_limited <- lm(
  log_price_diff ~ Limiting.Unavailable.Share + gen_tot,
  data= first_stage_data_clean_post_2021)
# Matrice de variance-covariance clusterisée
vcov_cluster <- vcovHC(m_limited, type = "HC0", cluster = ~ auction_date_plus_one)
# Erreurs standard clusterisées
cl_se_limited <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))


m_limited_published <- lm(
  log_price_diff ~ Limiting.Unavailable.Share + Published.Unavailable.Share + gen_tot,
  data= first_stage_data_clean_post_2021)
# Matrice de variance-covariance clusterisée
vcov_cluster <- vcovHC(m_limited_published, type = "HC0", cluster = ~ auction_date_plus_one)
# Erreurs standard clusterisées
cl_se_basic_limited_published <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))


```


```{r, results = 'asis'}

reg_table <- stargazer(m_real, m_real_published, m_limited, m_limited_published, 
    type = "html",
    se = list(cl_se_real, cl_se_real_published, cl_se_limited, cl_se_basic_limited_published),
    title = "Regression Results",
    column.labels = c("Predicted RF", "Predicted RF", "Limiting", "Limiting"),
    keep = c('Constant', 'Published.Unavailable.Share', "Limiting.Unavailable.Share",
             'Unpublished.Unavailable.Share', "Predicted.Unavailable.Share",'gen_tot')
)
 
```
